profile.description: Colorado River Indian Tribes / SDP-REC contact. Warm prior inquiry from Robin Howard. CRIT remains active in Parker, Arizona.

notes.subject: 2026 warm inquiry - pricing question went unanswered
notes.body: On June 4, 2026 Robin Howard replied to Adventure Zone outreach about a Parker July 4 celebration and asked for pricing for all units plus setup/breakdown and any other invoice costs. Gmail shows no later reply in that thread. The 2026 opportunity is past, but this should be treated as a warm relationship, not a cold lead. Current web research confirms the Colorado River Indian Tribes remains active in Parker, Arizona.

followUps.label: Reconnect with Robin for 2027 CRIT event
followUps.reason: Robin asked for full pricing in 2026 and the question appears to have gone unanswered. Reconnect early for the next event cycle and verify current event/date before quoting.
